This page is a roadmap of the '''Engineer referral network'''. It shows which Engineers can be approached independently and which Engineers are discovered through another Engineer.

For the exact discovery, meeting, invitation, permit, donation, rank, reputation, activity, commodity, or material requirements for an Engineer, follow the link to that Engineer's article.

For detailed step-by-step instructions, use the dedicated Field Procedure pages named '''Unlocking [Engineer]'''. The Engineer articles remain the reference pages for locations, capabilities, blueprints, and requirements.

See [[Engineers]] for the complete browsable directory of Engineers, their locations, and the Engineering they provide. For an example of a full step-by-step unlock procedure, see [[Unlocking Broo Tarquin]].

{{Field note|An Engineer appearing beneath another Engineer does '''not''' mean that referral is the only requirement. Many referred Engineers also have a separate meeting or unlock requirement that must be completed before their workshop becomes available.}}

== How Engineer referrals work ==

Some Engineers can be discovered without first progressing with another Engineer. These are the '''starting Engineers''' for their respective referral branches.

Other Engineers are discovered through referrals.

For ship Engineers, current Engineer data records referrals as being granted after sufficient reputation has been earned with the previous Engineer, generally during progression between '''Grade 3 and Grade 4 access'''.<ref name="inara-engineers">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineers/ Engineers], Inara.</ref><ref name="newp-engineers">[https://newp.io/engrhighlight Engineer Highlight], New Pilots Initiative.</ref>

A referral only causes the next Engineer to become known. It does '''not''' automatically unlock that Engineer's workshop.

Odyssey Engineers use a similar referral system, but progression to the next Engineer normally requires completion of a specific '''referral task''' rather than ship-Engineer reputation progression.<ref name="inara-engineers" />

{{Important|'''Ship Engineering and Odyssey Engineering are separate systems.'''

Ship Engineers modify ship modules. Odyssey Engineers modify suits and handheld weapons. Progress through one network does not replace progression through the other.}}

== Ship Engineer Unlock Paths ==

There are '''five independent starting Engineers''' in the ship Engineering network:<ref name="inara-engineers" /><ref name="newp-engineers" />

* [[Felicity Farseer]] <small>([[Unlocking Felicity Farseer|unlock procedure]])</small>
* [[Elvira Martuuk]] <small>([[Unlocking Elvira Martuuk|unlock procedure]])</small>
* [[Tod "The Blaster" McQuinn]] <small>([[Unlocking Tod "The Blaster" McQuinn|unlock procedure]])</small>
* [[The Dweller]] <small>([[Unlocking The Dweller|unlock procedure]])</small>
* [[Liz Ryder]] <small>([[Unlocking Liz Ryder|unlock procedure]])</small>

Each begins a separate referral branch.

=== Felicity Farseer branch ===

* '''[[Felicity Farseer]]''' — starting Engineer
** [[Juri Ishmaak]] <small>([[Unlocking Juri Ishmaak|unlock procedure]])</small>
*** [[Colonel Bris Dekker]] <small>([[Unlocking Colonel Bris Dekker|unlock procedure]])</small>
*** [[The Sarge]] <small>([[Unlocking The Sarge|unlock procedure]])</small>

[[Felicity Farseer]] is an independent starting Engineer. She does '''not''' require [[Elvira Martuuk]], and Elvira does not require Felicity. They belong to separate starting branches.<ref name="inara-engineers" />

After sufficient reputation has been earned with Felicity, she refers the Commander to [[Juri Ishmaak]].

Juri Ishmaak can subsequently provide referrals to both:

* [[Colonel Bris Dekker]]; and
* [[The Sarge]].

=== Elvira Martuuk branch ===

* '''[[Elvira Martuuk]]''' — starting Engineer
** [[Zacariah Nemo]] <small>([[Unlocking Zacariah Nemo|unlock procedure]])</small>
** [[Marco Qwent]] <small>([[Unlocking Marco Qwent|unlock procedure]])</small>
*** [[Chloe Sedesi]] <small>([[Unlocking Chloe Sedesi|unlock procedure]])</small>
*** [[Lori Jameson]] <small>([[Unlocking Lori Jameson|unlock procedure]])</small>
*** [[Professor Palin]] <small>([[Unlocking Professor Palin|unlock procedure]])</small>
** [[Mel Brandon]] <small>([[Unlocking Mel Brandon|unlock procedure]])</small> — Colonia

[[Elvira Martuuk]] is an independent starting Engineer and one of the largest referral hubs in the ship Engineering network.<ref name="inara-engineers" />

After sufficient reputation has been earned with Elvira, she can provide referrals to:

* [[Zacariah Nemo]];
* [[Marco Qwent]]; and
* [[Mel Brandon]] in the Colonia region.

[[Marco Qwent]] then leads to three additional Engineers:

* [[Chloe Sedesi]];
* [[Lori Jameson]]; and
* [[Professor Palin]].

{{Field note|A referral to a Colonia Engineer does not bypass that Engineer's own requirements. The Commander must still travel to the Colonia region and satisfy the Engineer's meeting and unlock conditions.}}

== Odyssey Engineer Unlock Paths ==

Odyssey Engineering has its own referral network for [[Suits]] and [[Handheld Weapons]]. It is separate from the ship Engineer network.

There are three independent starting branches in the core inhabited region and three independent starting Engineers in Colonia.<ref name="inara-engineers" />

=== Hero Ferrari branch ===

* '''[[Hero Ferrari]] <small>([[Unlocking Hero Ferrari|unlock procedure]])</small>''' — starting Engineer
** [[Wellington Beck]] <small>([[Unlocking Wellington Beck|unlock procedure]])</small>
*** [[Uma Laszlo]] <small>([[Unlocking Uma Laszlo|unlock procedure]])</small>

[[Hero Ferrari]] is available without a prerequisite Engineer.<ref name="inara-engineers" />

After Hero has been unlocked and her referral task has been completed, she introduces [[Wellington Beck]].

After Wellington Beck has been unlocked and his own referral task has been completed, he introduces [[Uma Laszlo]].

The branch is therefore:

<pre>
Hero Ferrari
└── Wellington Beck
    └── Uma Laszlo
</pre>

=== Jude Navarro branch ===

* '''[[Jude Navarro]] <small>([[Unlocking Jude Navarro|unlock procedure]])</small>''' — starting Engineer
** [[Terra Velasquez]] <small>([[Unlocking Terra Velasquez|unlock procedure]])</small>
*** [[Oden Geiger]] <small>([[Unlocking Oden Geiger|unlock procedure]])</small>

[[Jude Navarro]] is available without a prerequisite Engineer.<ref name="inara-engineers" />

After Jude has been unlocked and his referral task has been completed, he introduces [[Terra Velasquez]].

After Terra Velasquez has been unlocked and her referral task has been completed, she introduces [[Oden Geiger]].

The branch is therefore:

<pre>
Jude Navarro
└── Terra Velasquez
    └── Oden Geiger
</pre>

=== Domino Green branch ===

* '''[[Domino Green]] <small>([[Unlocking Domino Green|unlock procedure]])</small>''' — starting Engineer
** [[Kit Fowler]] <small>([[Unlocking Kit Fowler|unlock procedure]])</small>
*** [[Yarden Bond]] <small>([[Unlocking Yarden Bond|unlock procedure]])</small>

[[Domino Green]] is available without a prerequisite Engineer.<ref name="inara-engineers" />

After Domino has been unlocked and her referral task has been completed, she introduces [[Kit Fowler]].

After Kit Fowler has been unlocked and his referral task has been completed, he introduces [[Yarden Bond]].

The branch is therefore:

<pre>
Domino Green
└── Kit Fowler
    └── Yarden Bond
</pre>

=== Colonia Odyssey Engineers ===

The Colonia Odyssey network does not use a normal linear referral chain.

Three Engineers can be approached independently:<ref name="inara-engineers" />

* '''[[Baltanos]] <small>([[Unlocking Baltanos|unlock procedure]])</small>'''
* '''[[Eleanor Bresa]] <small>([[Unlocking Eleanor Bresa|unlock procedure]])</small>'''
* '''[[Rosa Dayette]] <small>([[Unlocking Rosa Dayette|unlock procedure]])</small>'''

Each has a separate referral task associated with [[Yi Shen]] <small>([[Unlocking Yi Shen|unlock procedure]])</small>.

Yi Shen requires the referral tasks from '''all three Engineers''' to be completed before access is granted.<ref name="inara-engineers" />

The relationship is therefore:

<pre>
Baltanos ──────┐
Eleanor Bresa ─┼──► Yi Shen
Rosa Dayette ──┘
</pre>

Yi Shen should not be treated as the direct successor of any one of those Engineers. All three contribute to his discovery and unlock path.

== Odyssey Engineer tree at a glance ==

Jude Navarro

    └── Oden Geiger

Domino Green
└── Kit Fowler
    └── Yarden Bond

Baltanos ──────┐
Eleanor Bresa ─┼── Yi Shen
Rosa Dayette ──┘
   [Colonia]
</pre>

== Reading the roadmap ==

This page describes '''referral relationships only'''.

A starting Engineer can still have requirements that must be met before their workshop becomes available.

Likewise, being referred to an Engineer does not mean that Engineer is immediately unlocked. Depending on the Engineer, the Commander may still need to complete requirements involving:

* Pilots Federation rank;
* Federal or Imperial Navy rank;
* superpower or minor-faction reputation;
* a system permit;
* travel distance;
* combat, trading, mining, or exploration activity;
* missions or settlement activity;
* commodity deliveries;
* Engineering materials or data;
* bounty vouchers or combat bonds; or
* another Engineer-specific task.

Those requirements are documented on the individual Engineer pages rather than duplicated here.

== Notes ==

* '''Starting Engineer''' means that no prerequisite Engineer referral is required. It does not mean the Engineer has no access or unlock requirements.
* A referral makes another Engineer available to pursue; it does not automatically grant workshop access.
* Ship Engineer referrals depend on reputation progression with the preceding Engineer.
* Odyssey referrals generally use explicit referral tasks.
* Colonia ship Engineers are reached through the normal ship referral network but are physically located in the Colonia region.
* [[Yi Shen]] requires completion of the referral tasks associated with [[Baltanos]], [[Eleanor Bresa]], and [[Rosa Dayette]].
* Ship Engineering and Odyssey Engineering are independent progression systems.
* Exact Engineer requirements are maintained on the individual Engineer pages so that this roadmap can remain focused on the referral network.
